prs.head: copilot/landing-page-smoke-tests
prs.title: Add Playwright smoke tests for the landing page
prs.body:
Work in progress for #5.

## What changed
- Adds `@playwright/test` config that serves `docs/` on port 8000.
- First two smoke tests: arrow-key tab navigation and reduced-motion rendering.

## Remaining
- [ ] Pause/Play, Home/End, and guide-to-chat tests
- [ ] Add a `package.json` with `@playwright/test` and a `test:e2e` script
- [ ] Document the command in the README

prs.head: feature/keynote-highlights
prs.title: Render keynote highlights with a topic filter
prs.body:
Closes #3

## What changed
- New "Keynote highlights" section above the keynote call to action.
- Loads `universe-notes/notes/keynote-highlights.json` and renders each highlight's title, summary, and "Try it" text.
- Topic filter buttons ("All" plus each topic) narrow the list.

## How I verified it
- Opened the page from the repository root with a local static server and clicked through each topic filter.

## Checklist
- [x] Matches existing visual language
- [ ] Tests for the filter logic

prs.head: feature/terminal-copy-button
prs.title: Add a Copy button to the CLI terminal demo
prs.body:
Closes #2

## What changed
- Added a **Copy** button next to Pause and Replay in the terminal bar.
- Clicking it copies the terminal example to the clipboard and shows "Copied" for two seconds.

## How I verified it
- Served `docs/` with `python3 -m http.server 8000 --directory docs`.
- Clicked **Copy** on the Stacked PRs tab and pasted into a text editor.

## Checklist
- [x] Keyboard reachable
- [ ] Screen reader announcement
- [ ] Tests
